verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that hybrid search runs full-text and vector search in one request, with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) recommended to merge the rankings [elastic-docs-2, elastic-docs-16, elastic-docs-24]. Vector similarity is supported via semantic_text, dense_vector and sparse_vector fields [elastic-docs-1, elastic-docs-19], and the docs describe combining it with full-text search in one engine [elastic-docs-4]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that hybrid queries work as documented.
